scope: Theorem 1 (subexponentialRate, Challenge.lean, proved in Solution.lean): one Mathlib Turing.TM2ComputableInTime machine with input and output encodeNat (binary) computes Nat.minFac N, every stack alphabet finite, and for every k >= 1 some C_k bounds its time by C_k * 2^(n/k) on inputs of n bits. That is time N^{o(1)} = 2^{o(b)}: score 0. Neither the Lean statement nor the paper gives an explicit rate, so no positive score. Theorem 2 (full factorization, by at most log2 N calls) is not in Lean.
conjecture: Conjecture 1 (SqrtLogLogConjecture), factoring in time exp(O(log N/sqrt(log log N))), is stated in Challenge.lean as a Prop and is not proved. It scores nothing.
lean: Lean v4.35.0, Mathlib v4.35.0 (56a005855ea17e0b0958f73ec801ae140b0a1679); comparator.json: Factoring.subexponentialRate, axioms propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice. 146 Lean files, 36,356 lines; imports Mathlib only. No site rerun.
authors_statement: Authors: Isaac Rudich and Louis-Martin Rousseau (Polytechnique Montreal). README: the ideas and the Lean code were generated by AI (Claude, Anthropic); the authors posed the questions and designed and audited the statement, and did not read the proof.
